lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: STOP! [beat] That red light wasn't a warning, it was the countdown to the total destruction of every student record in this building!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You idiot! [beat] You didn't just stop the cryogenic process, you triggered the fail-safe protocol I spent ten years perfecting!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Nix, look at the monitors! [beat] The data is literally melting off the screens, and the server room door just magnetically locked us inside!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, if the records are being wiped, [beat] then why is my name the only one flashing in neon green across the entire mainframe?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Because you were never meant to be a student here, Nix. [beat] You were always the core source code for the entire system!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I’m looking at the code right now and it makes no sense! [beat] Nix, your DNA sequence is being used as the encryption key for the Principal’s secret files!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: My DNA? [beat] That’s impossible, I’ve lived in this city my whole life, and I have a family and a birth certificate to prove it!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Those memories were uploaded into your brain [beat] the same way I’m currently downloading the school’s black budget into my private offshore account!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: She’s using the virus as a smokescreen! [beat] She’s wiping our identities so she can disappear with millions of dollars while we take the fall!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I won’t let you do this! [beat] Riku, if you can bridge the connection to my phone, maybe we can override the purge before it hits 100 percent!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: It’s too fast! [beat] The virus just reached the 'Final Delete' stage and the fire suppression gas is starting to fill the entire lab!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Goodbye, Nix. [beat] By the time the police arrive, you won’t even remember your own name, let alone what happened in this basement!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The lights are flickering out... [beat] Tuli, I’m starting to forget... why did we even come down here in the first place?
